media.title: Flag of Iraq.svg
media.artist: See File history below for details.
media.credit:
Own work. This vector image and its matching construction sheet are based on the Government flag image shown at protocol-pmo.gov.iq.  Several very small adjustments have been applied to improve symmetry, character alignment, and character spacing.  Note that the flag image shown on the government web page (and referenced above) is very likely derived from a previous version of this Wikimedia file.


See also Flags of the World - Iraq.
Also in use as current Air Force roundel seen here
